prompts.prompt: Participants should also have a search screen
prompts.text:
Participant phone: join page (/join/:code from QR) → nickname →
  room view with two tabs: Search (search box → results → "Add to queue") and
  Queue (live list, own songs highlighted). Host's phone gets the same
  view plus a Controls tab (play/pause/skip/volume/reorder/remove) — role decided by
  the signed identity, one route serves both.
